description: Save a new quote when asked. Reuse request_id for retries; a different ID creates another quote.

category.description: Quote source and app icon: other = quotation bubble, book = book, audio = microphone, web = globe, video = television, mail = envelope. Optional; defaults to other.

metadata.description: Optional custom string fields, using native template names: {"Book Title":"Walden","Page":"61"}, {"URL":"https://example.com/article"}, {"Podcast Name":"Example Show"}, or {"Topic":"Courage"}. Keys: 1–100 characters; values: up to 4000; at most 32 fields and 24000 encoded bytes. Empty or omitted means no metadata.

name: add_quote
